The Bid Award Panel adopted the following: 1. Bid Award Panel grant authority to award the contract in accordance with the Contract Details set out in the report (March 15, 2018) from the Chief Purchasing Officer: Call Number: Tender Call 14-2018 Description: For the supply of all labour, materials, products, equipment, and supervision required to complete state-of-good repair improvements to the Baycrest Arena at 160 Neptune Drive, Toronto, on behalf of the Parks, Forestry and Recreation Division. Recommended Bidder or Proponent: Frank Pellegrino General Contracting Ltd. Contract Award Value: $3,087,500 net of all applicable taxes and charges $3,488,875 including HST and all applicable charges $3,141,840 net of HST recoveries Contract is expected to start on date of award and end on December 31, 2018.
